assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area polygons are provisional (official_boundary=false), inferred from public data; not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, and layout metrics must be recomputed when official polygons are published; results are intake-level discussion only.

assumptions.statement: The three key areas (众智园 / 北京AI原点社区 / 大钟寺) use provisional geometry; building clusters inside them are concept-level layout, not surveyed building stock.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint 28,507 m² is a design-concept footprint; official building stock and 拆改留 conclusions require field survey and 控规 conditions.

assumptions.statement: Green ratio 2.85% and public space ratio 3.93% cover only the submitted design area interior; the adjacent 9km / 53公顷京张遗址公园绿廊 and 清河/小月河 blue-green network serve the belt as regional open space.
assumptions.impact: Regional green supply is higher than the interior-only metric; final green/public-space indicators should be agreed with the official boundary and 绿线 scope.

assumptions.statement: Road network (33,008 m) is a design-level slow-traffic and micro-circulation proposal; red lines, cross-sections, and municipal conditions are not yet confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Traffic conclusions are provisional; intersection and 轨道一体化 designs need official road, rail, and utility conditions.

assumptions.statement: Floor area ratio, building height, density, setback, and building control lines are not asserted as fixed values; they are listed as unknown/pending_control until 控规 conditions are available.
assumptions.impact: No false precision is introduced for statutory control values.

assumptions.statement: Industry scale (4500亿元 / 3500亿元), policy funds (90/80/20亿元), 京张公园二期, 大钟寺字节收购 and tax-policy references are public background data, not official planning or approval basis.
assumptions.impact: These figures support narrative and industry research only; official planning documents remain the authority for any statutory conclusion.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, 开发者社区, 活动周, and 运营机制 are concept proposals for professional teams to deepen; they are not committed government programs.
assumptions.impact: Operation subjects, frequencies, and funding paths require separate agreements and cannot be read as implementation promises.
